title: Client Intake Document Request Form
subtitle: A controlled document request package record for a prospective client's first contact before representation is accepted, separating requested help, adverse parties, timing, communications, conflict-screen inputs, and engagement status, carrying facts and source evidence through qualified decision, exception escalation, secure communication, and accountable handoff.
description: This original Client Intake Document Request Form helps the intake coordinator and supervising lawyer manage a prospective client's first contact before representation is accepted, separating requested help, adverse parties, timing, communications, conflict-screen inputs, and engagement status. It defines a proportionate document need, recipient authority, secure transmission, receipt inventory, deficiency follow-up, and custody disposition, while keeping jurisdiction-specific conclusions and professional judgment with authorized reviewers.
use_case: Use when the intake coordinator and supervising lawyer needs one fillable record that defines a proportionate document need, recipient authority, secure transmission, receipt inventory, deficiency follow-up, and custody disposition for the pre-engagement inquiry. Close only after the document request disposition is supported by evidence and accepted by the named recipient.

sections.title: Prospective Client Intake record identity and routing
sections.guidance: Open one traceable record, establish authority, and assign accountable qualified review.

blocks.guidance: Use approved secure systems for protected communications and source files. Do not enter access credentials, complete account numbers, government identifiers, medical detail, or privileged source content in this routing form.

sections.title: Prospective Client Intake facts and source evidence
sections.guidance: Capture domain-specific facts, distinguish statements from verified evidence, and retain source references.

blocks.label: Prospective Client Intake matter profile
Prospective Client Intake evidence checkpoints
items: Prospective-client status is stated and no engagement is implied
Requested outcome is recorded in the prospective client's own words
All known opposing, related, and affiliated names are captured
Known hearings, notices, deadlines, and limitation concerns are flagged
Communication language, accessibility, and safe-contact needs are routed
Only information reasonably needed for intake and conflict review is collected
Documents received are stored by secure reference rather than embedded here
Any preliminary communication is separated from accepted legal advice
blocks.guidance: Check only supported items; explain any limitation in the evidence narrative.

sections.title: Prospective Client Intake document request package control record
sections.guidance: Turn the record purpose into traceable evidence, accountable actions, and reviewable decisions.

blocks.label: Document need, recipient, timing, and secure route
Prospective Client Intake document-request controls
items: Each requested category is necessary for a stated legal-office task
Recipient identity and authority to provide the material are confirmed
Date range, custodian, repository, format, and exclusions are explicit
Request avoids credentials, originals, or sensitive data unless specifically required
Privilege, work product, privacy, confidentiality, and protective-order review is routed
Secure transmission, access, receipt confirmation, and retention are assigned
Unavailable, incomplete, or disputed materials have a deficiency response route
Received material cannot be disclosed, filed, or produced without separate authorization

blocks.label: Requested-document inventory and receipt reconciliation
Scope explanation, secure delivery instructions, exclusions, and deficiency route

fields.label: Scope explanation, secure delivery instructions, exclusions, and deficiency route

sections.title: Prospective Client Intake stop conditions, exceptions, and escalation
sections.guidance: Stop when authority, identity, evidence, deadline, confidentiality, or professional-duty controls are unresolved.

blocks.label: Stop and escalate when any condition is present
items: A hearing, filing, response, appeal, or limitation date may be imminent
An adverse or related person may be a current, former, or prospective client
The inquiry includes confidential information beyond what intake needs
The caller's identity, authority, capacity, or relationship is uncertain
A third party appears to control the contact or requested outcome
The requested service is outside licensed jurisdiction or firm capability
The prospect relies on an unconfirmed promise of representation or action
Safety, coercion, language access, or disability accommodation needs escalation
blocks.guidance: A checked item requires immediate protective action, a named owner, qualified review, and a final disposition.

blocks.label: Document Request Package exception and escalation register
Objective facts, affected activity, containment, notifications, and review needed

fields.label: Objective facts, affected activity, containment, notifications, and review needed

blocks.label: Qualified review and record boundary
blocks.guidance: This template records operational facts and does not determine legal rights, professional duties, privilege, conflicts, consentability, deadlines, or court compliance. Follow applicable jurisdictional rules and current firm policy; route legal, ethics, privacy, tax, court, safety, and specialist questions to authorized reviewers.

sections.title: Prospective Client Intake qualified decision and accountable authorization
sections.guidance: Record the authorized decision separately from preliminary analysis and prevent action beyond its evidence and scope.

blocks.label: Document Request Package qualified decision
Prospective Client Intake decision and execution conditions
items: Conflict review is complete for all supplied names and relationships
A qualified lawyer has reviewed urgency, venue, scope, and capacity
Engagement, limited engagement, referral, or non-engagement status is explicit
Any accepted scope and excluded tasks are documented in the proper agreement
The prospect receives accurate next-step and deadline-responsibility language
No work begins until required authorization and system opening are complete
blocks.guidance: Check only controls supported by cited evidence; unresolved items remain open conditions.

blocks.label: Evidence considered, reasons, limits, alternatives, and required follow-up

fields.label: Evidence considered, reasons, limits, alternatives, and required follow-up

blocks.label: Preparation, qualified review, and independent authorization
blocks.guidance: Signatures acknowledge the recorded decision and scope; they do not replace required agreements, consents, notices, filings, or system approvals.

blocks.label: Decision-use limitation
blocks.guidance: Do not use this Prospective Client Intake record as a substitute for legal advice, a required client agreement, informed consent, court paper, discovery response, privilege review, or specialist determination. Execute only the action evidenced in the approved system of record.

sections.title: Prospective Client Intake completion, evidence reconciliation, and handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when the outcome is evidenced, limitations remain visible, and every open action has an accountable owner.

blocks.label: Document Request Package outcome and primary handoff
Prospective Client Intake closeout evidence
items: Final intake disposition and responsible lawyer are recorded
Engagement or non-engagement communication delivery is evidenced
Received property and documents have a secure custody disposition
Unresolved deadline concern has an owner and immediate escalation route
Conflict-search and consultation records have the approved access restriction
Follow-up, referral, or matter-opening handoff is acknowledged
blocks.guidance: Unchecked items require an exception disposition or a documented reopen trigger.
